doc: A 0.4-day rotator: Hadley edge 12.03 degrees, so x reaches 7.5 (the polar smoothstep is saturated over most of the hemisphere) and the scale is gh / (omega_a / omega_a_earth) = 0.4. 181 float64 latitudes -90..90 every degree. Float64 closed form (gaussians, a smoothstep, a scale): rtol 1e-9. Arguments: lat (input, rad), hadley_deg and body (params). Measured: one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 6.7e-15 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is about 2e4x that spread.
